notes.title: August Update
notes.content: [p]Hello! As always I want to start by thanking all the people who continue to wishlist and follow the game. It's really encouraging to see the continued interest, even with the slow pace of these updates.[/p][p][/p][p]There's been lots of new systems coming online since the last update, and continued iteration on existing systems to ensure everything has the right feel, fun, and balance. Including:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Characters[/b][/p][p]A long desired feature of mine, characters are finally in the game. Though not fully featured yet, they come with traits and can be assigned to ships and colonies to provide powerful bonuses. Creating your own characters, finding characters lost in space, and progressing characters are all on the to-do list for the full feature.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Planet Destruction[/b][/p][p]What sci-fi 4X would be complete without planet destruction? Not this one. Once the aliens discover one of your colonies they will stop at nothing to destroy it. Eventually sending planet killers - massive ships, bristling with weapons, and capable of destroying entire worlds (see below for a preview)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Economy[/b][/p][p]Production is no longer a global resource, instead production is local to each colony. However, when colonies are connected together by a jump network they can share resources. Meaning that a colony specialized in mining can directly support a colony specialized in ship production - so long as you protect and maintain the connection.[/p][p][/p][p]And much more! But for now, please take a look at some of the latest screenshots below.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your time and continued interest[/p][p]Best regards,[/p][p]-Josh[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301991/14757243b62acace73935e418543f0ae4487bb11.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301991/33a2302b42f5a5610f308826f5ca98b6e8a6ab4b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301991/ad148e7531fbfa59ece560994d328c1d5dea519c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301991/f8334e77739b65e50a2400c386ceb533203a60e2.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301991/6cd9fef126e224a360346b5d210e26719cfc86fb.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: March Update
notes.content:
Hello! It's been too long since my last update. I want to thank everyone again who has wishlisted or followed the game, and for your patience. It's really appreciated.

I'm happy to say work continues. My focus remains on getting all major systems represented in the game, finding the fun, and working towards an early preview demo around summer. Leading into early access later in the year.

Along with implementing systems, I'm working on replacing the marketplace ship assets with unique designs that are more thematically appropriate. These may still undergo significant iteration, but you can see some of the initial work below.

That's all for now, but hopefully I will be back soon with some deeper dives into features.

Thanks!
-Josh

notes.title: An introduction, some background, and the road to early access
notes.content:
[h3][b]Introductions[/b][/h3]

Hello! My name is Josh and I’m currently the sole developer on Stellar Dynasty. I wanted to take a moment to thank everyone who’s already shown interest in the game by following or wishlisting. It’s really exciting to be on this journey with you all and I hope you’ll enjoy what’s to come.

Although I’m an experienced developer, I’m new to the sole dev thing and new to Steam, so please bear with me as I get my footing.

[h3][b]Background[/b][/h3]

Stellar Dynasty has been in development for about a year as of this posting. It’s still early days and a lot will change in the coming months. This will be an iterative process.

The basics: it’s a slower paced, streamlined (more on this below), pause and play RTS at its core, blending elements from many genres including 4X, Rogue-like, and RPG.

As a designer I like to focus on the player experience, while creating a rich world and deep systems the player can get lost in and which are capable of delivering fantasy fulfilling moments.

A word on streamlined: to me it means focusing on mechanical depth over complexity, so fewer things with deeper interactions.

[h3][b]Road to Early Access[/b][/h3]

What’s currently been shown is very early days. The intent is to have all major features in the game and a complete core gameplay experience before releasing into early access. If all goes as planned, It won't necessarily be pretty, but it'll be functional and fun.

As features come online and get iterated on I hope to post more updates like this to keep the community informed.

Finally, why early access? There is no doubt strategy games are complicated and the sooner more eyes are on the project, the better it will be. 

If anything here peaks your interest, I hope you’ll join in!

Thanks!
-Josh
